title: Add OnBeforeFilterRemovedSourceRecords integration event in Email Impl
summary: An OnBeforeFilterRemovedSourceRecords integration event was added to the Email codeunit to let partners override the default permission checking logic for source records, resolving issues with security-filtered users unable to find attachments.
key_points: New integration event allows subscribers to customize how read permissions are checked on source records
Partners can apply SecurityFiltering or other logic before the permission check runs
Purely additive change with no impact on existing behavior when the event is not subscribed to
Follows the existing event pattern in the Email codeunit
Solves the issue where security-filtered users cannot see attachments in the Add file from source document action
